subject: The 2AM mistake that changed everything
preview_text: I almost deleted SoulPlan at 2AM. Here's what saved it and how it can save your date night.
body_paragraphs: It was 2AM, I was running on three hours of sleep and a cold cup of coffee, and I almost deleted the whole app. I had been building SoulPlan for months, but that night I realized something: couples don't need another calendar full of reminders. They need a reason to stop planning and start connecting.

So I scraped everything and started over. I built one feature — just one — that would make planning a date feel like a moment, not a chore. That's how Tonight's Date was born. One tap on your mood, and in 30 seconds you have a plan that feels like it was made just for the two of you. No scrolling, no decision fatigue, no 'I don't know, what do you want to do?'

That 2AM mistake became the heart of SoulPlan. When your partner sends a date, they get a full-screen 'thought of you tonight' moment — not a boring notification. It's the closest thing to a handwritten note in a digital world. And the memory timeline captures every date you've shared, so you can look back and see how far you've come.

Tonight, I want you to try something. Open SoulPlan, tap Tonight's Date, pick any mood — cozy, adventurous, playful, healing — and send it to your partner. See what happens. It takes 30 seconds, and it might just change your night. P.S. Couples who use this in their first 24 hours plan 4x more dates over the next month. That's not a stat I made up at 2AM. It's real.
